I looked at the crash report from this morning. The app closes when the user opens a project while the board is still loading. I think the loading state is cleared too early, so the page tries to read a list that does not exist yet. Can you add a check before we read the list, and write a test that opens a project during loading? It would also help to show a small spinner in the sidebar, so people know the board is not ready. When you are done, send me the branch and I will review it after lunch.
